# Macmillan Learning

> Macmillan Learning provides comprehensive digital learning platforms and educational technology solutions for instructors and students, centered around the Achieve platform with integrated assessment, engagement, and academic integrity tools.

Macmillan Learning is a leading educational technology provider offering digital courseware, interactive learning tools, and classroom solutions. The site serves educators and students with products like Achieve (learning management platform), iClicker (classroom response system), and LearningCurve (adaptive learning technology).

## Key Topics

- Achieve platform
- Digital learning platform
- iClicker
- LearningCurve
- Student engagement
- Assessment tools
- Interactive learning

- Adaptive learning

- Educational technology

- Teaching resources
